newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Johnson & Johnson to set up Irish operation.
newsitem.headline: Johnson & Johnson to set up Irish operation.

text.p: Healthcare company Johnson & Johnson will invest 31 million Irish pounds to establish a major manufacturing operation and a technical support centre for orthopaedic products in Cork.
The investment, which is backed by Irish industrial development agency IDA Ireland, will create 300 new jobs over the next three years, the Irish government said in a statement.
The new facility will manufacture artificial replacement hip and knee joints for worldwide markets and will also produce a wider range of products for the European market.
